items.excerpt: Steinberg has released SpectraLayers 13, a major update to its spectral-editing app whose AI-assisted 'unmixing' separates a finished recording into independent instrumental stems and isolates individual sound components with new accuracy.

Audiotool 3.0 rebuilds the browser-based multiplayer DAW as an open platform via a new SDK called NEXUS, which lets creators build custom instruments/plugins and supports AI integrations through MCP so producers can connect their own LLMs to the workflow.

Eldoraudio launched a free browser-based tool that uses a note-detection model to convert guitar recordings into editable MIDI files — upload audio, set the BPM, and get a MIDI transcription ready to drop into a DAW, with a dedicated model for distorted/overdriven guitar planned.
